title: TTFT-Quality Comparison
data_scope: Current root outputs/*.output, model-specific selected settings
meaning: Compares TTFT and F1 or Rouge-L for the three methods across two models and three datasets.
paper_use: Useful as a companion figure to the total-latency comparison when Chapter 4 discusses first-token delay.

title: Selected Setting Score Bars
data_scope: Three datasets, Qwen and Yi under model-specific selected settings
meaning: Compares the selected-score levels of full reuse, query-aware, and full prefill across both models within each dataset.
paper_use: Useful for a compact side-by-side comparison of method quality under the chosen settings.

title: Yi-6B Quality Baseline Curves
meaning: Shows how score changes with recompute ratio, with both Full Reuse and Full Prefill shown as references.
paper_use: Useful for discussing both quality recovery over reuse and the remaining gap to full prefill.

title: Yi-6B Speed Baseline Curves
meaning: Shows how TTFT changes with recompute ratio, with both Full Reuse and Full Prefill shown as references.
paper_use: Useful for discussing where Query-Aware sits between the fastest and the slowest first-token baselines.

title: Yi-6B TTFT-Total Latency Structure
meaning: Separates first-token delay from total generation latency and marks how quality changes along the curve.
paper_use: Useful when Chapter 4 discusses TTFT rather than only total latency.

title: Quality Retention vs Full Prefill
data_scope: Both models, three datasets, all qaw-ratios
meaning: Highlights which ratios preserve or exceed full prefill quality.
paper_use: Useful for selecting qaw-ratio and explaining dataset-specific quality behavior.

title: Query-Aware Score Delta against Baselines
data_scope: Both models, three datasets, all qaw-ratios
meaning: Shows whether query-aware recomputation improves over full reuse and how far it is from full prefill.
paper_use: Good for explaining quality recovery and degradation cases.
